sources.label: Official Fisch Wiki - Items Totems table

items.name: Sundial Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Sunken Chests, Daily Shop, Sunstone Cave (-1215, 195, -1040)
items.cardSummary: Speeds the server through day and night cycles, which helps fish, events, and hunts tied to time.

items.name: Clearcast Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Moosewood (701, 250, 305)
items.cardSummary: Forces clear weather when a catch, condition, or event setup needs the sky reset.

items.name: Tempest Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Sunken Chests, Terrapin Cave (20, 140, 1860)
items.cardSummary: Forces rain for rain-preferred fish and rain-linked server activity.

items.name: Windset Totem
items.sourceLocation: Snowcap Cave (2845, 180, 2700)
items.cardSummary: Forces windy weather for wind-preferred fish and wind-based rod/enchant setups.

items.name: Smokescreen Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Sunken Chests, Mushgrove Swamp (2790, 140, -625)
items.cardSummary: Forces fog for fog-preferred fish and event setups that need foggy weather.

items.name: Aurora Totem
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Treasure Chests, Rare Goods Dealer
items.cardSummary: Starts Aurora Borealis for a major server luck window.

items.name: Eclipse Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Sunken Chests, Ancient Isle (5940, 265, 900)
items.cardSummary: Starts the Eclipse event, mainly used when a player needs that special sky condition.

items.name: Blue Moon Totem
items.sourceLocation: Snowcap Island Blue Moon room, Personal Aquarium (2715, 140, 2480)
items.cardSummary: Starts Blue Moon when the season, weather, and night-cycle requirements line up.

items.name: Starfall Totem
items.sourceLocation: Fallen Stars, Personal Aquarium, Codes, Angler's Quest, Totem Carver, Black Market
items.cardSummary: Starts Starfall for star-linked catches and event windows.

items.name: Rainbow Totem
items.sourceLocation: Angler's Quest, Totem Carver, Treasure Hunting, Rare Goods Dealer
items.cardSummary: Starts Rainbow weather, one of the strongest special weather windows for fishing.

items.name: Sparkling Totem
items.effect: Summons a Day or Night of the Luminous.
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Daily Shop, Codes, Totem Carver
items.cardSummary: Starts a luminous event, with day or night behavior depending on the current server state.

items.name: Zeus Storm Totem
items.sourceLocation: Atlantis Zeus Trial (-4325, -625, 2685)
items.cardSummary: Starts Zeus Storm and can trigger Zeus Trial room hazards and lightning-related rewards.

items.name: Cursed Storm Totem
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Rare Goods Dealer
items.cardSummary: Starts a Cursed Storm pool for Cursed mutation and XP-focused fishing.

items.name: Brine Storm Totem
items.sourceLocation: Axel's quest, Rare Goods Dealer
items.cardSummary: Starts a Brine Storm and is limited by quest/Rare Goods Dealer availability.

items.name: Meteor Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Daily Shop, Sunken Chests, Treasure Chests, Roslit Volcano (-1945, 275, 230), Maple Meadow (-447, 134, 3496)
items.cardSummary: Starts a meteor event from several shop, chest, and map sources.

items.name: Avalanche Totem
items.sourceLocation: Northern Expedition (19711, 468, 6059)
items.cardSummary: Starts the Avalanche event in Northern Summit/Northern Expedition progression.

items.name: Blizzard Totem
items.sourceLocation: Northern Expedition (20148, 743, 5804)
items.cardSummary: Starts Blizzard conditions, including mutation-focused fishing during the event.

items.name: Poseidon Wrath Totem
items.sourceLocation: Atlantis Poseidon Temple (-3955, -555, 855)
items.cardSummary: Starts Poseidon Wrath and ties into Atlantis/Kraken-focused progression.

items.name: Dripstone Collapse Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Tidefall (-3158, -1105, 788)
items.cardSummary: Starts Dripstone Collapse, a high-cost event used for essence-focused progression.

items.name: Bloom Totem
items.effect: Resets all flowers in Living Garden and Verdant Pocket.
items.sourceLocation: Living Garden NPC quests, Gardener's Exchanges (20% chance)
items.cardSummary: Resets flower spawns for Living Garden and Verdant Pocket progression.
items.sourceStatus: Official table plus sparse internal page

items.name: Shiny Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Daily Shop, Codes, Totem Carver
items.cardSummary: Starts a Shiny Surge for players chasing shiny catches.

items.name: Mutation Totem
items.sourceLocation: Personal Aquarium, Daily Shop, Codes
items.cardSummary: Starts a Mutation Surge for players chasing mutated fish.

items.name: Megalodon Hunt Totem
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Personal Aquarium, Codes, Totem Carver, Mysterious Songstress's Fifth Quest
items.cardSummary: Starts a Megalodon Hunt directly instead of waiting on natural hunt timing.

items.name: Kraken Hunt Totem
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Personal Aquarium, Codes, Totem Carver
items.cardSummary: Starts a Kraken Hunt directly for players targeting Kraken hunt catches.

items.name: Colossal Dragon Hunt Totem
items.effect: Summons a Colossal Ethereal Dragon Hunt, Colossal Ancient Dragon Hunt, or Colossal Blue Dragon Hunt.
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Personal Aquarium, Codes
items.cardSummary: Starts one of the Colossal Dragon hunt variants.

items.name: Scylla Hunt Totem
items.sourceLocation: Daily Shop, Personal Aquarium, Codes, Totem Carver
items.cardSummary: Starts a Scylla Hunt directly for players targeting Scylla hunt catches.
